subject: Isolation surcharge & SLA banding for Dedicated commit
messages:
From: Alice Jones <alice.jones@ivycapital.com>
To: david.kim@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@ivycapital.com
Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Pricing for isolated Dedicated pool + compliance add-ons

Hi David,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. We need a clear pricing structure for a Dedicated (single-tenant) deployment that meets our compliance bar: VPC isolation, customer-specific KMS, 12 month retention audit logs, and role-based access auditing. Key asks from procurement: 1) a per-month committed price for a 12- or 24-month reserved commit (we'll be evaluating both), 2) the percent surcharge for single-tenant isolation/air-gapped networking, 3) any line-item for KMS integration and audit log retention, and 4) throughput guarantees (we target steady-state 400 tokens/sec sustained, with spikes to 1,200 tokens/sec).

Also please include proposed SLA credit bands tied to throughput (e.g., credits if sustained throughput falls below X for Y window) and any minimum commit sizing (GPUs / vCPU equivalents) you recommend. We will share the security questionnaire after we have a rough commercial.

Can you send a straw-man by EOD Tuesday?

Best,
Alice Jones
Head of Procurement — Ivy Capital
From: david.kim@redwood.com
To: Alice Jones <alice.jones@ivycapital.com>
Cc: monica.patel@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pricing for isolated Dedicated pool + compliance add-ons

Alice —

Thanks. Quick straw-man below so you have something to react to. Attaching a compact pricing sheet (proposed_pricing_sheet.xlsx) and a draft SOW (IvyCapital_SOW_v1.pdf).

High-level:
- Baseline Dedicated (shared tenant control plane, isolated GPU pool): $120k/mo for a 24-GPU pool (NVIDIA H100 equiv), sized to deliver ~450 tokens/sec sustained for interactive inference across 8 concurrent application routes.
- Single-tenant isolation premium (private control plane + network isolation + dedicated hardware reservation): +22% on baseline committed price.
- KMS integration: one-time integration fee of $18k + $0.015 per 1k keys per month for key rotation/audit hooks.
- Audit log retention (12 months, immutable): $6k/mo plus $0.005 per GB ingested.
- SLA & throughput banding: we propose three bands — Gold (>=95% of requested sustained throughput), Silver (>=90%), Bronze (<90%). Credit schedule: Gold: no credits; Silver: 10% credit for the month; Bronze: 25% credit + optional remediation plan. Band thresholds are measured over 1-hour sliding windows.
- Commit terms: 12-month & 24-month pricing available; 24-month gets a 9% commit discount on baseline (applied before isolation premium).

Notes / assumptions: 1) Spikes to 1,200 tokens/sec are handled via burst pool (pay-as-you-go burst at $0.12 per 1k tokens) — continuous spikes will require upsizing the reserved pool; 2) Exact throughput mapping depends on model family and max prompt lengths — we used LlamaX-70B perf profile for sizing.

Next steps: Monica, Marissa — can you confirm if we can offer a deeper isolation discount for 24-month commit if Ivy pre-buys capacity (e.g., asked-for faster credits or additional support)? Alice — once you confirm target commit length and expected 99th percentile request size we can firm up sizing.

—
David Kim
Enterprise Sales — Redwood Inference
From: monica.patel@redwood.com
To: david.kim@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 6 Nov 2026 09:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pricing for isolated Dedicated pool + compliance add-ons

Looping legal/finance context: we can flex isolation premium down if the customer takes a larger committed pool or accepts a 60% payment-upfront schedule. Suggested counter-offer language: reduce isolation premium to 15% for 24-month, 20% for 12-month if they commit to >= 36 GPUs reserved. We should also make KMS integration a capped professional services line (cap $25k) if they require custom HSM work.

Marissa — pricing for audit retention: can you confirm compliance storage egress assumptions? I used 2 TB/mo for initial calc but if Ivy has heavier logging we need to flag.

Monica Patel
Director, Commercial Operations
From: Alice Jones <alice.jones@ivycapital.com>
To: david.kim@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@ivycapital.com
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 10:34:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pricing for isolated Dedicated pool + compliance add-ons

David / Monica —

Thanks for the straw-man. A few clarifications from our side:
- We are evaluating a 24-month commit but want the option to scale after month 12 with a repriced band. Target starting size: 32 GPUs.
- The 400 tokens/sec number is an average across bursty pipelines; sustained 60-minute windows should meet 400, with allowed short spikes to 1,200.
- For audit logs, current estimate is ~3 TB/mo.
- KMS: we require customer-managed keys with HSM-backed rotation (will need input from our security engineers).

Commercial ask: if Redwood can commit to Gold SLA for the first 12 months on the 32-GPU 24-month commit, would you be willing to offer a 12% overall discount including isolation premium, and cap integration fees at $20k? Also request a 30-day right-to-terminate for convenience in the first 90 days if performance materially deviates (we're willing to accept some pro-rated settlements).

Can you run this by finance/legal and send a revised pricing + SOW markup?

Best,
Alice
From: david.kim@redwood.com
To: Alice Jones <alice.jones@ivycapital.com>
Cc: monica.patel@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 14:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pricing for isolated Dedicated pool + compliance add-ons

Alice —

We can accommodate most of this. Revised offer (summary):
- 24-mo commit, 32 GPUs reserved: baseline $160k/mo.
- Offer: 12% overall commercial discount applied to baseline for the duration if customer signs within 30 days. This includes a reduced isolation premium at 15% (as Monica suggested), and caps KMS integration at $20k.
- Audit log retention priced at $8k/mo for 3 TB baseline (additional $0.005/GB).
- Gold SLA guarantee for months 1–12: commit to >=95% sustained throughput measured over 1-hour windows for the reserved pool. Remedy: 10% service credit on months that miss Gold by margin <5%; 25% credit if miss >=5% plus remediation/upsizing plan.
- Termination: 30-day right-to-terminate during first 90 days with a pro-rated return of unused prepaid months less a 15% operational uplift fee.

Attachments: updated SOW with these terms and a revised pricing sheet. If this looks acceptable we will prepare a DocuSign SOW and a HubSpot quote.

Proposed next step: David to run final SOW with legal; Marissa to prepare final numbers for finance approval. Alice — can you confirm the internal security contact for HSM/KMS so our engineering team can scope the integration?

Thanks,
David
From: marissa.cole@redwood.com
To: david.kim@redwood.com, monica.patel@redwood.com, Alice Jones <alice.jones@ivycapital.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 15:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pricing for isolated Dedicated pool + compliance add-ons

Alice —

I reviewed with finance; the 12% sign-within-30-days discount is approved contingent on a 24-mo non-cancelable core commit (we'll allow the 30-day early termination you requested but it will trigger the 15% uplift and reconciliations). I've attached the revised SOW with redlines.

We will provision a dedicated engineering onboarding window (two weeks) to validate throughput with your security contact. Please send the HSM contact and a preferred NDA for HSM access.

If Ivy signs the SOW by 2026-12-12 we'll honor the pricing and the capped KMS integration fee.

—
Marissa Cole
Head of Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference
